verdict.rationale: Dagster's dbt integration lets dbt models be modeled as assets with dependencies, and Declarative Automation / AutomationCondition (e.g. on_cron, eager materialization) can trigger asset materialization based on upstream data freshness rather than a blind timer, plus asset checks can verify freshness before/after runs. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on case study specifically confirming event-driven dbt runs (vs docs-only claims), and no explicit worked example tying sensors/upstream data-loading events directly to dbt run triggers.
